She is surrounded by three other cosplayers in traditional costumes: Sun Wukong (the Monkey King) on the left in his iconic yellow attire and monkey mask; Sha Wujing (Sandy) on the right in brown robes; and Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) standing behind, looking on with a concerned expression. The group appears to be gathered closely around the central figure, suggesting a moment of intense discussion or discovery within their narrative. The background features warm, reddish tones and what appear to be small statues, enhancing the temple-like setting.
